_: Team radio lines: id -> [who, text] (e = race engineer, d = driver). Numbered lines are HRC_complete_team_radio_library_350.txt word for word, only those the game uses. {placeholders} are filled in by the game; their words are the files <id>_a, <id>_b ... and the values are read out with n0-n59 / oh / point. tools/radio-voices.ps1 makes sounds/radio/*.mp3 and voices.json.
